svg.title: Rotor circuits
svg.text: DCCREG turbine: the rotor's two circuits as built (tube, wound utrons; rotor and counter-rotor geared 1 : −1)

(a) the reluctance pump drives the AH pair · (b) the electrostatic pump's rings hold a DC field on the AH null; only C1 / C2 straddle the bodies · operating point g 0.5 / 6 bridges / 1200 rpm relative · only diodes switch
(a) RELUCTANCE: magnetic dual doubler → AH pair
(b) ELECTROSTATIC: de Queiroz diode doubler → DC field on the null
6 SiFe bridges per side: passive iron, no wires
B row 30° offset · radial gap 0.5 mm at r 130 mm
ROTOR · the whole circuit, no rotating contact
into the utron loop at start-up
stator vanes only: the reference plates of C1 / C2, no HV
joined to the shaft through one inner bearing (right)
ROTOR · the HV circuit and the core, no rotating contact
C_A, Co, Cs 100 pF · ground = the shaft
wound utrons at 0 / 120 / 240°, 200 t of Ø1.55 mm Cu: 81.0 / 9.4 mH (aligned / unaligned), 0.58 Ω each
L̂ 0.243 H, ratio κ 8.6, τ = L/R 0.140 s; Ψs 0.134 Wb-t (the 3.0 mm NiFe neck)
a passing bridge closes the utron's flux path: L(θ) 6 × per rev; B row half a pitch on
anti-Helmholtz pair at the hub, one coil per branch: 160 t, 1.01 mH, 0.27 Ω each [RH]
0.146 H DC chokes: 0.87–1.15 A, ≤ 110 V, 0.29 Ω (τ 0.5 s [RH]); not designed
first cut [RH]: gapped EI of M235-35A, 28 mm leg, 179 t, 0.21 mm gap, 1.0 kg Fe + 0.4 kg Cu each
4.4 mH wiring stray, as modelled (dual of Cpar) [IR]
Si, 0.55 V at 1 A; 2.8 A peak; reverse 112 / 101 / 43 / 45 V peak
At 1200 rpm relative (120 Hz): 0.87–2.81 A in each branch, 101 V peak per group; AH 139–449 A-turns.
Belt 17.6 W = utron Cu 6 × 2.15 + La / Lb 0.66 + AH 2.00 + diodes 2.01 W; + iron 1.25 W = 18.8 W.
6 + 6 vanes, 6 × 22° / 22°, 6 mm air gaps, 3 mm full rounds: 55–410 pF, κ 7.5
451 pF (1.1 C_max): full-annulus plates, now on the rotor
HV stacks, reverse peaks 6.2 / 6.1 / 13.2 / 13.2 kV; parts not chosen
avalanche strings, BV 13.1 kV (e.g. 66 × 200 V), on the rotor: 1.04 W, 0.93 mA peak each
two rings outside the 50 mm glass: bands 20–53°, 32.2 mm apart along it
A: Dk + C_A on node 1's peak, −13.2 kV · B: three CW stages on node 4, +19.0 kV
C_A, Co, Cs 100 pF; Dk, Dc, Dp see ≤ 7.5 kV reverse
32.2 kV across: 7.8 kV/cm, 2.7 Pa at the null (as connected; 8.9 settled)
≈ 20 pF per node [RH]; the rings 7.4 pF each to REF, 1.3 pF between
one inner bearing, for now: 0.40 mA rms AC (0.90 mA pk), no DC
At 1200 rpm relative (120 Hz): belt 2.15 W, into Z1 + Z4; z at start 1.178 (bare 1.310).
Leakage only (54 mW at 10 GΩ [RH]); 1 / 2 stages give 5.7 / 7.1 kV/cm: sim/hub-locked-findings.md.
Bodies. Rotor: shaft, sleeve, rotor vanes (nodes 1 / 4), Ca / Cb plates, the 6 utrons on their carrier discs, the hub (the glass vessel with the rings outside it, the AH pair, retainer and coupler).
Counter-rotor: stator cage, stator vanes (REF), bridges. Frame: end bearings, the gear.
Not in the solids yet: La, Lb, D1*–D4*, the RC snubbers, the kick source, D1–D4, Z1 / Z4, Dk, the CW stage, C_A, the rings (all rotor);
sim/tube_geometry.py still puts Ca / Cb on the counter-rotor. Each pump's reaction torque goes into the gear.
(a) is the planar dual of (b) [OC]: C → L, V → I, Q → Ψ, Ca / Cb → La / Lb, Cpar → Lp2 / Lp3, D1–D4 → D1*–D4*, the clamps Z1 / Z4 → the NiFe neck's saturation.

A and B swap every half cycle: one group generates (L falling) while the other motors. The AH coils are named by branch; sim/magnetic_doubler.py calls them AH top / bottom (A was then the upper side).

Polarity: (b) runs negative; ring A takes node 1's negative peak and ring B three CW stages positive: E at the null is steady, B to A. de Queiroz's Fig. 1 draws the core positive, all four diodes the other way (sim/queiroz_fig1_check.py).

Numbers: sim/pole_design_variants_op.json (g 0.5 / 6 bridges / 1200 rpm), sim/utron_profile.py, sim/rotor_parts_duty_results.json, sim/core_field_results.json, sim/hub_locked_results.json (b: the air build's capped stack)
Netlists: sim/magnetic_doubler.py, sim/core_field.py · findings: sim/pole-design-findings.md, sim/hub-locked-findings.md · generator: docs/make_schematic_rotor.py
